title: まちのこうじ (Machi no Kouji)
description: It's road construction season in the shopping district. The south exit of the station is blocked, the water pipes need replacing, and the sidewalk is torn up. A local shopkeeper, the project foreman, and a city official navigate weeks of noise, detours, and neighborhood complaints — discovering that rebuilding a street also rebuilds community ties.
author: オリジナル
